pain: Operators need safe enrollment and runner lifecycle controls.
done_when: Human-admin-only lifecycle routes enforce reviewed enrollment and audited resume, drain, disconnect and revocation with atomic revision checks.
Disconnect finalization requires fresh current stopped, idle and admission-closed evidence before disabling the Homer binding.
UI disables mutations on failed or mixed-revision readback and preserves uncertain outcomes until manual readback, without automatic replay.
Controller connection and runner state remain separate; Homer revocation never claims GitHub or Cloudflare credentials were revoked.
Browser tests cover lost responses, competing writes, busy disconnect, finalization, reconnect and mobile layout; singleton audience correction remains effective.

out_of_scope: Live credentials and Access policy changes
